sources.title: Federal Reserve Board, K.8 Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026

sources.quote: the Federal Reserve Banks observe the following holidays: all Saturdays, all Sundays and the holidays listed on the Federal Reserve Banks’ Holiday Schedules. Each calendar day that is not a holiday observed by the Federal Reserve Banks is a funds-transfer business day. The funds-transfer business day ... begins at 9:00 p.m. ET on the preceding calendar day ... and ends at 7:00 p.m. ET.
